steps.u: The OpenAPI descriptions for the /forecast endpoints are one-word placeholders. Write real descriptions and an example response for each.

steps.r:
/forecast/{station}:
  get:
    description: forecast
    parameters:
      - name: horizon
        in: query
        description: hours

i.new_string:
description: Predicted tide heights in metres for one station, hour by hour, up to 72 hours ahead.
    responses:
      '200':
        content:
          application/json:
            example: { station: ST-0042, unit: m, heights: [1.2, 1.4, 1.7] }

steps.r: Woohoo! Your API description is valid.

steps.a: The descriptions now match the handler, including the 72 hour limit, and the spec passes lint. Only the station forecast endpoint had enough in the code to document; the other two forecast endpoints are still placeholders because I couldn't tell their response shape.
